responsibility: Provides GCC’s null debug back end: a complete gcc_debug_hooks instance whose callbacks intentionally do nothing, plus the stub implementations for each hook signature. This file belongs to the compiler’s debug-output abstraction layer and serves as the default or fallback debug writer when no real format-specific producer is active, supplying harmless implementations for source-file, block, function, type, label, variable-location, and external-DIE registration callbacks while preserving the expected hook interface used throughout the compiler.
same_name_distinction: Provides the concrete no-op implementation of the generic debug hook interface from debug.h, including the do_nothing_debug_hooks table and stub callback bodies used when no real debug writer is active.
